During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''officer''' was bribed by members of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. The information he provided allowed the spynet to acquire information regarding a [[Death Star II/Legends|secret Imperial project]].
